key_insight: Conformal prediction can lose coverage for time-dependent PDE surrogates because solution distributions can differ sharply even at arbitrarily close times.
engineering_relevance: Uncertainty bounds for PDE surrogates in flood forecasting or thermal control require explicit treatment of temporal distribution shift to avoid systematic undercoverage.
method: Prove that solution distributions at arbitrarily close times can be mutually singular in function space.
Analyze how spatial grid resolution drives total variation distance toward saturation.
Use principled weighted conformal prediction to obtain finite-sample coverage over growing time horizons in certain settings.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical results on distribution shift, discretization, and coverage guarantees, but provides no datasets or numerical evaluation metrics.
watch_item: Weighted coverage guarantees apply only in certain settings, and spatial discretization may need restrictions to preserve coverage.
